sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US rate-cut expectations structurally favor long-duration renewable assets and utility capex cycles, compressing discount rates on FSLR/ENPH-style cash flows.
Indonesia's energy transition hinges on JETP-linked grid upgrades and captive industrial solar PPAs, rewarding developers with bankable off-takers (PCG, MPOW) over speculative capacity.
Climate-tech bifurcation persists: US policy-driven demand (IRA credits) outpaces Indonesia's regulatory lag, making US-listed names the safer beta for regional capital.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US-listed renewables (FSLR, ENPH) and defensive utilities (EIX, PPL) on rate-cut tailwinds; Indonesia underperformed (-0.59%) but PCG/MPOW strength signals selective domestic appetite—rotate into names with contracted PPAs and grid-expansion exposure. Trim pure-play Indonesian developers lacking financing clarity; favor US yield-sensitive equipment makers into Q4.

The persistent ID-vs-US spread indicates local currency stability and improving purchasing power, underpinning a durable consumption upgrade cycle in tier-2/3 cities.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum in small/mid-cap consumer names (KKES, TOOL, WMPP) while large-cap FMCG lags; the ID outperformance vs US signals domestic demand resilience. Rotate into high-beta winners with volume confirmation, but trim any holding that breaks its 5-day average. Focus on names with earnings catalysts or new product launches within 30 days to capture follow-through.
